+def joint_chunk(actions, dt=1/30, tag='joint'):
+    """Submit and persist one joint-position chunk."""

"""Control client for the live BEHAVIOR-1K packing_meal_for_delivery episode."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path('/app/output')
RUNS = Path('/app/runs')
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
(OUT / 'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
obs = r.get_obs()
obs.save(str(RUNS / '001_ready'))
print('connected', r.base, 'proprio', obs.meta['proprio']['now'])

def watch(seconds=0.0, tag='watch'):
    """Get current RGB observations, optionally holding the last command."""
    o = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video='frames' if seconds else 'frames')
    o.save(str(RUNS / tag))
    print('watch', tag, 'meta=', o.meta, 'proprio=', o.meta.get('proprio'))
    return o

def joint_chunk(actions, dt=1/30, tag='joint'):
    """Submit and persist one joint-position chunk."""
    a = np.asarray(actions, dtype=np.float32)
    res = r.submit('joint_position', a, dt=dt, video='mp4', note=tag)
    res.save(str(RUNS / tag))
    np.save(RUNS / tag / 'actions.npy', a)
    print('submit', tag, 'meta=', res.meta)
    return res

def drive(dx=0.0, dy=0.0, dyaw=0.0, n=1, tag='drive'):
    """Apply small local-frame base steps while holding measured arm joints."""
    p = r.get_obs().meta['proprio']['now']
    # The three base controls are virtual; q3..q24 track the 22 trunk, arm,
    # and gripper joints in the joint_position action block order.
    body = np.asarray(p[3:25], dtype=np.float32)
    row = np.r_[np.array([dx, dy, dyaw], dtype=np.float32), body]
    actions = np.repeat(row[None, :], int(n), axis=0)
    return joint_chunk(actions, dt=1/30, tag=tag)

def ee_chunk(rows, tag='ee'):
    """Submit world-frame dual end-effector targets (16 columns per row)."""
    a = np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32)
    res = r.submit('ee_pose', a, video='mp4', note=tag)
    res.save(str(RUNS / tag))
    np.save(RUNS / tag / 'actions.npy', a)
    print('submit', tag, 'meta=', res.meta)
    return res
